MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Darius T. Chan, Esq. appeared for plaintiff City Home Construction Inc.
Eric Huang, Chief Executive Officer for plaintiff, was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant Angelia Green.
Default was entered against defendant on February 13, 2009.
Doe defendants were dismissed on May 1, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff City Home Construction Inc., and against the Defaulted Defendant Angelia Green as follows:

Damages/Principal - $28,260.00.
Prejudgment Interest - $2,887.02.
Costs - $410.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $31,557.02.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
